description: Secondary app windows that run our own frontend: the clipboard popup, dock, the Linux tab-strip windows, the split frame (one window holding a bar and child webviews), and the popup bar (one Save as app button docked under a popup). Without a capability these windows get no core permissions at all — the clipboard popup's onFocusChanged listener was ACL-rejected (focus-loss auto-hide never ran) and the tab strip's close() was denied.
